notablePrerequisites: Tempting Licid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tempting Licid by tapping it and paying {G}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two Human Soldier creature tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Human Soldier creature token, adding {G} each time.
Pay {G} to end Tempting Licid's effect, making it a creture once more.
Resolve both Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
